notes: Created BDD plan for panel-swap-during-multitouch bug fix. Read the change request, all 4 source files (PanelSwap.js, MultiTouchHandler.js, createCollageData.js, createCollageLifecycle.js), both existing test files (PanelSwapTest.html, MultiTouchHandlerTest.html), and the predecessor plan (2026-07-29-mobile-touch-enhancements.md). Consulted @world-review for UX perspective on gesture edge cases (single-finger stabilize, gesture-to-swap transition, 3+ finger OS gestures, real-device test priorities). Consulted @planner for test scenario design, phased approach, and shared-state concerns. Plan specifies Solution A (move dragSourceId to state.dragSourceId, clear in startGesture and _onPointerCancel, add _onPointerMove guard) with 27 BDD scenarios across 5 levels (user behavior, PanelSwap component, MultiTouchHandler component, integration, pure function), 16 automated success criteria, 7 manual verification steps, and 13 known behaviors/edge cases.
